finding: The reviewed sage protocols concern rodent nociception and neuropathic models. Their primary exposures and administration routes differ from fresh sage, without a Parkinson result.
The sage section cites a mouse vincristine neuropathy study. The same Abad study appears in the 2018 review and supplies no independent human result.
The author abstract concerns topical herbal treatments for herpes labialis. Botanical component effects and primary pain tables need separate verification.
Existing oral-rinse comparison favored benzydamine in the surgical pain setting. Both groups received NSAIDs and no swallowed whole-leaf exposure was assigned.
